items.question: How early before relocating should we engage Meridian?
items.answer: Ideally 8 to 14 weeks prior to your intended start date. This leaves buffer for apostilles, employer sponsor allocations and consular biometrics slots without rush fees.

items.question: Do you work with corporate HR teams or individual applicants?
items.answer: Both. Around half of our practice supports founders and senior individuals directly, while the remainder acts as an embedded mobility desk for scaling technology and engineering companies.

items.question: Can spouses and children be filed in the same dossier cycle?
items.answer: Yes. Where statutory rules allow concurrent filing, we synchronize principal and dependant evidence—including school placements and marriage legalisations—so households travel together.

items.question: What happens if an application previously received a refusal?
items.answer: We conduct a written refusal audit first to establish whether an administrative review or a restructured re-application with fresh documentary evidence offers the strongest path.

items.question: Are legal fees fixed per stage rather than open hourly retainers?
items.answer: Every route comes with a fixed written milestone fee agreed before work begins, separated transparently from mandatory government and biometric tariffs.

items.question: How does your team manage document translation and apostilles?
items.answer: We coordinate certified translations and Hague Convention apostilles across forty-two civil registries so documents meet exact consular format on first submission.
